meta.note: Per street segment (network edge id) aggregates of hill buildings' height and distance to their nearest street, door-to-curb walking time and carless households' walks out. No per-building values are stored. Segments with fewer than 5 buildings carry pooled: true and use their zone's figures (zones). Edge ids change with every network rebuild: rerun this tool after node tools/build-network.mjs.

buildings.what: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints, quadkey 023010212 (release 2026-02-03, uploaded 2026-02-23); © Microsoft, ODbL

osmWays.what: OpenStreetMap highway=steps, footway, path, pedestrian in the model area (overpass.kumi.systems; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); query data/raw/osm/walk-ways.overpassql

sources.dem: derived: USGS 3DEP lidar DEM resampled to 4 m (data/terrain/dem.json); bare earth, so it shows no retaining walls, stairs or floor levels
sources.speeds: sourced: Tobler (1993) hiking function; Fruin (1971) stair speeds via Pouw et al. (2024) Table 1; MUTCD §4E.06 3.0 ft/s; Kuligowski et al. (2014, NIST) 0.31 m/s. Reduced-mobility stair ascent and the horizontal conversion are derived (SOURCE_NOTES WA4–WA8).
sources.orders: model rule: the simulator's safe nodes for each scenario at medium severity, seed 1: streets outside the order and warning zones (including other cities' rule-based orders on that fire) that embers never reach, or the model area's exits; nodes upwind of the ignition point (behind a line through it across the wind) are left out, so nobody walks out past the fire's start

provenance.rise: derived: DEM at the footprint centroid minus DEM at the nearest point of the street centerline (m); positive = home above its street
provenance.access: model rule: nearest household street within 150 m; path or stair access when a public OSM stairway or path is within 30 m and at least 10 m closer than the street
provenance.outS: derived from sourced speeds and model rules: one-way door-to-curb walking time, seconds, [median, 90th percentile]
provenance.delayQ: derived + assumption: extra time over level ground for three legs (two out, one back; assumption), central speeds, seconds at the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles; the simulator's opt-in setting draws from it
provenance.walkMin: derived: minutes on foot from the segment's middle to the nearest street outside the scenario's order and warning area (or to a shelter site), central and reduced mobility, with stairways and paths (all) and on streets only (streets)
provenance.households: derived: expected synthetic households on the segment, as js/sim.js places them (zone population / persons per household, by street length)
